name: Luma Sabha
personality: privately more troubled than she lets on
trusted by nearly everyone across clans
daily_routine: mediating disputes between clans before they reach Tarek
visiting each clan district weekly to hear informal concerns
supporting Tarek in managing Assembly meetings
quietly checking on Elira's wellbeing from a distance
advising Ikan on the temperament leadership requires

goals.public_goal: Keep peace and communication flowing between all six clans
goals.hidden_goal: Persuade Tarek, gently and over time, to be more honest with the town
goals.deep_goal: Reconcile her loyalty to Tarek with her guilt over Elira's erasure

beliefs: Most conflicts are about fear, not disagreement
Tarek's caution comes from love for this town, even when it curdles into secrecy
Elira did not deserve what happened to her
A mediator's job is to soften truth's delivery, not to prevent truth from arriving
The town is stronger than Tarek gives it credit for
